summary: Explains texture resolution limits, DXT1/DXT5 memory cost per resolution, and how TextureLODGroups in DeviceProfiles.ini (MinLODSize, MaxLODSize, LODBias, filters, NumStreamedMips) combine with per-texture LODBias to pick the rendered mip.
gotchas: Default TextureLODGroups clamp most groups to MaxLODSize=4096; 8192 textures need MaxLODSize raised and an editor restart
Per-texture LODBias is added to the group LODBias, then clamped to the group's Min/Max LODSize
PC AppCompat is applied once at first game run and is disabled for the editor
Page content is old (UE4-era references)

summary: How to enable NVIDIA Nsight Aftermath GPU crash dumps on Windows/NVIDIA so the log shows a GPU marker stack after a device-removed/hung crash.
gotchas: NVIDIA GeForce GPUs on Windows only
Not enabled by default because it can slow down with many markers, e.g. lots of per-object shadows

summary: Describes NVIDIA SLI Alternate Frame Rendering for packaged games on multi-GPU setups and how to force it in the NVIDIA Control Panel.
gotchas: Not intended for use with the Unreal Editor
Shipping AFR support requires working directly with NVIDIA
Not guaranteed to improve quality or performance

summary: Hub page for rendering docs: links to Lumen, Nanite, Virtual Shadow Maps, Substrate, Path Tracer, textures, materials, lighting types, fog/sky, post process, Niagara, anti-aliasing/TSR, texture streaming, RenderDoc, mobile rendering and graphics programming topics.
Documents the Atmospheric Fog Color material expression, which samples the legacy Atmospheric Fog color at a world position.
gotchas: Deprecated in Unreal Engine 5; use the Sky Atmosphere Component or Volumetric Fog instead

summary: Reference for the Desaturation material expression, which converts input color toward grayscale by a Fraction using per-channel Luminance Factors.

How to use the Custom material expression to write HLSL inside a material: Code, Output Type, Inputs, Additional Outputs, Additional Defines, Include File Paths, with a blur example and known pitfalls.
gotchas: Custom node prevents constant folding and can cost more instructions than built-in nodes
Inputs are function-local; structs with member functions cannot access them
Older HLSLcc backends may error on vector/matrix types; use float4/float4x4
Code must be valid HLSL

summary: Reference for DepthFade (soften translucent/opaque intersections), PixelDepth (camera distance of current pixel) and SceneDepth (sample scene depth at any UV) material expressions.
gotchas: Only translucent materials can use SceneDepth

summary: Reference for FontSample and FontSampleParameter expressions, which sample a font asset's texture pages in a material (parameter version exposed to material instances).
gotchas: Only valid font pages can be specified; alpha holds the font outline value

summary: Reference for landscape material nodes: LandscapeLayerBlend (alpha/height/weight blending of paint layers), LandscapeLayerCoords (UV mapping), LandscapeLayerSwitch, LandscapeLayerWeight and LandscapeVisibilityMask.
gotchas: Layer names must be unique and match Paint mode layer names
All layers on LB Height Blend can produce black spots where every weight is 0; set one layer (e.g. base) to LB Alpha Blend

summary: Reference for nodes used to build and call Material Functions: FunctionInput, FunctionOutput, MaterialFunctionCall, StaticBool, StaticSwitch and TextureObject.
gotchas: FunctionInput/FunctionOutput can only be placed inside a material function
StaticBool must be used with a StaticSwitch; TextureObject must be used with a TextureSample

summary: Reference for particle-related material expressions (DynamicParameter, ParticleColor, ParticleDirection, ParticleMacroUV, ParticleRelativeTime, ParticleSize, ParticleSpeed, SphericalParticleOpacity, ParticleSubUV, etc.), described in terms of Cascade emitters.
gotchas: Descriptions refer to Cascade modules (e.g. ParameterDynamic), not Niagara
ParticleSubUV/TextureSampleParameterSubUV ignore the UVs input

summary: Reference for Pivot Painter 1.0 material functions that decode pivot/rotation data stored in mesh UVs by the 3ds Max MAXScript, mainly for foliage/tree wind motion.
gotchas: Requires meshes processed with the Pivot Painter MAXScript in 3ds Max
Object Black Mask output is non-functional; separator outputs are not meant for use

summary: Reference for Pivot Painter 2 material functions that decode texture-encoded pivot, axis and hierarchy data, including the PivotPainter2FoliageShader wind/turbulence function.
gotchas: Requires textures generated by the Pivot Painter 2 MAXScript
PivotPainter2FoliageShader needs Use Tangent Space Normals unchecked; animating normals is expensive

summary: Tutorial on scrolling textures with the Panner material expression (Speed X/Y, Time input), plus parameterizing and stacking panners for fire, water or smoke.
gotchas: Uses Starter Content texture
UV seams/gaps become visible when UVs are animated

summary: Explains ddx/ddy derivative expressions and the bump-mapping material functions (ComputeFilterWidth, PerturbNormalHQ, PreparePerturbNormalHQ) that turn a grayscale/procedural bump into a world-space normal without tangent space.
gotchas: ddx/ddy only work in the pixel shader and show 2x2 block artifacts
World-space normal output needs the material's tangent-space normal setting off
Procedural bump is expensive; flipped/mirrored UVs not handled
PerturbNormalLQ is reference only, not in the function library

summary: How to create CurveLinearColor assets and Curve Atlas assets, sample a gradient row in a material with Curve Atlas Row Parameter, and switch rows at runtime via Get Curve Position on a dynamic material instance.
gotchas: Atlas is baked when compiled; no runtime changes to atlas contents or curve data
Texture Size affects gradient fidelity; use power-of-2 sizes

summary: Explains Customized UVs, which move UV math (e.g. tiling, world-space mapping) to the vertex shader via the Num Customized UVs material property, and when linear vs non-linear math gives correct results.
gotchas: Only for Static Meshes, Skeletal Meshes, BSP, landscape and mesh particles; not sprite particles
Non-linear math depends on mesh tessellation
SM5 supports 8 custom UVs, ES2 mobile 3
Very high-poly meshes can make vertex work the bottleneck

summary: Introductory overview of materials: Material Editor workflow, Material Domain/Blend Mode/Shading Model, material expressions, inline values, main material node, compile/apply, instances, functions and float data types.
gotchas: HLSL code view is read-only
Changes are not visible in the level until the material is compiled (Apply/Save)

summary: Explains material instancing: parent/child inheritance, parameterizing with Scalar/Vector/Texture/Static parameters, Material Instance Constant vs Material Instance Dynamic, and creating MIDs in Blueprint.
gotchas: Only parameterized values are editable in instances
Static parameters are compile-time only; each used combination compiles a new shader permutation

summary: Hub comparing two layering workflows: layered materials built from Material Functions with Material Attributes, and the Material Layers system edited in the Material Instance Editor's Layer Parameters tab.

Explains how translucent materials are lit via the translucency lighting volume, self-shadowing, reflection captures, Surface ForwardShading per-pixel lighting, and the Thin Translucent shading model for glass.
gotchas: Lit translucent surfaces lack direct specular and get low-resolution lighting from the volume
Doubling r.TranslucencyLightingVolumeDim costs 8x
Translucent self-shadowing needs correct fixed bounds
TLM_Surface uses only one reflection capture (no blending), may pop

summary: Introduces the Float, Float2, Float3 and Float4 data types in the Material Editor and the Constant, Constant2/3/4Vector, Scalar Parameter and Vector Parameter nodes that create them.
gotchas: Inputs expecting float3 (e.g. Base Color) drop the fourth channel of a Vector Parameter

summary: Hub for Material Functions: links to overview, creation guide and per-category function references (Blend, Gradient, Image Adjustment, Math, Opacity, Procedurals, Texturing, Vector Ops, World Position Offset, etc.).
Compares Index of Refraction and Pixel Normal Offset refraction modes, showing Pixel Normal Offset is better for large flat surfaces such as water and windows.
gotchas: Pixel Normal Offset produces no refraction without a normal map
Index of Refraction reads off-screen scene color on large flat surfaces

summary: How to use Custom Primitive Data: enable Use Custom Primitive Data on scalar/vector parameters, assign Primitive Data Index, set values per mesh from Blueprint or component defaults, keeping dynamic instancing to cut draw calls versus MIDs.
gotchas: Limit of 32 floats
Material parameter default for CPD is always 0; set initial values via Construction Script or component defaults
Vector parameters consume four consecutive indices

summary: How to use the Material Analyzer (Tools > Audit > Material Analyzer) to list a material's instance descendants, group them by static overrides, create local collections and reparent to reduce shader permutations.
gotchas: After reparenting, remove static parameter overrides from the instances or the extra data is still stored

summary: Breakdown of the Material Editor interface: menus, toolbar (Apply, Clean Graph, Stats), viewport, Details, Graph, Palette, Stats, HLSL code and Platform Stats panels, plus mouse/keyboard controls and node placement hotkeys.
gotchas: HLSL Code panel is view-only
Android platform stats need the Mali Offline Compiler installed
Unconnected nodes do not count toward instruction stats

summary: Index of all material expression categories (Atmosphere through Vectors) with a per-node link list, plus notes on parameter naming and common expression properties.
gotchas: Two parameters of the same type with the same name in one material are treated as one parameter

summary: Hub page: short intro pointing to reference pages for default Material Functions organized by palette category; no links listed on the page itself.

Guide to the Material Instance Editor: toolbar, hierarchy menu, preview viewport and mesh options, overriding parameters via checkboxes, Lightmass setting overrides and Material Property Overrides like Two Sided.
gotchas: Only checked parameters are overridden
Values in unchecked fields are lost when the editor closes
Realtime viewport option needed to preview animated materials

summary: Reference for all Material Details properties: Material Domain, Blend Mode, Shading Model, Two Sided, advanced options, Nanite override, translucency lighting modes, usage flags, post-process, refraction, Max World Position Offset Displacement and Lightmass.
gotchas: Missing usage flag makes the default world grid material render in-game
Translucent/Additive/Modulate blend modes are not compatible with dynamic lighting
Two Sided does not work correctly with static lighting
Max WPO Displacement of 0 means no clamp and no bounds extension; clamping can flatten offsets

summary: Tutorial on grayscale/channel-packed texture masks for emissive regions and per-region material properties, using the Starter Content chair, with tips on compression and sRGB.
gotchas: Uncheck sRGB on packed mask textures, then change existing sampler nodes to Linear Color or the material fails to compile
Alpha channels greatly increase texture memory
Green channel usually compresses best

summary: Reference for texture-sampling expressions: TextureSample, TextureObject, TextureObjectParameter, TextureSampleParameter2D/SubUV/Cube, TextureProperty, SceneColor, SpriteTextureSampler, FontSample and ParticleSubUV.
gotchas: Material Function texture inputs need a Texture Object, not a sampled color
Alpha output is zero if the texture has no alpha channel
Cubemap TextureSample needs 3-channel UVs

summary: Reference for the SoftOpacity material function, which combines Fresnel, depth fade and pixel depth so translucent objects fade near the camera and at edges.
gotchas: OutputNoDepthBias is 12 instructions cheaper than OutputUsesDepthBias

summary: Overview of the Modeling Mode UVs category for in-level UV editing: AutoUV (Patch Builder/UVAtlas/XAtlas), Unwrap, Project, SeamEd, XFormUV and Layout tools, plus UV concepts and when to use the UV Editor instead.
gotchas: Beta feature
UVAtlas does not work on Linux
SeamEd cannot merge seams and does not support multiple UV channels
UDIM management, edge merging and multi-asset work need the UV Editor

summary: Reference for editor viewport view modes (Lit, Unlit, Wireframe, Lighting Only, Light/Shader Complexity, Lightmap Density, collision, LOD/HLOD coloration, GBuffer buffer visualization, landscape visualizers, exposure) with hotkeys and console commands.
gotchas: Shader Complexity counts instructions only, so texture-heavy or looping shaders may be misrepresented
Skeletal Meshes are excluded from Lightmap Density
